- [ ] **Step 7: `components/stepUp.tsx` y sus textos**

Crear `frontend/src/components/stepUp.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * THE RECENT CONFIRMATION OF THE SECOND FACTOR (own authentication design §2.5).
 *
 * Changing your own password or second factors, resetting another person's
 * factors and checking a credential out of the vault need the second factor
 * confirmed in the last 10 minutes. The SERVER decides that, on every such
 * request: one it refuses answers 403 `{"code": "step_up_required"}`, in the
 * body or in its `detail`. Nothing here is a check -- the console keeps no
 * clock of its own and never skips a request because it believes the
 * confirmation is fresh (invariant 6: the console gates nothing).
 *
 * WHAT THIS DOES WITH THAT ANSWER. `run(action)` sends the request. On that
 * one refusal it opens a dialog asking for a passkey, a code from the
 * authenticator app or a recovery code -- passkey first, the design's order --
 * sends it to `/auth/step-up/*`, and only after the server ACCEPTS it sends
 * the same request once more. A second refusal comes back as it came: no loop,
 * and no retry the server did not make possible. Closing the dialog rejects
 * with `StepUpCancelled`, so the caller's mutation ends saying nothing changed.
 * Several requests waiting at once share one confirmation.
 *
 * NOTHING TYPED HERE IS KEPT. The boxes are emptied each time the dialog opens
 * or closes and once the server has accepted a code; the passkey assertion
 * goes from the browser to the server and nowhere else.
 *
 * The person's own methods come from `GET /me/security` (`MY_SECURITY_KEY`,
 * the cache key the security page shares), read only while the dialog is open.
 *
 * RENDER `dialog` OUTSIDE ANY `<form>`: it holds forms of its own, and nested
 * forms are invalid HTML. A caller with another dialog open under it passes
 * `dismissible={!stepUp.open}` to that one, so Escape answers this one only.
 */

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { startAuthentication } from "@simplewebauthn/browser";
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";

import { useT } from "../i18n/context";
import { translate } from "../i18n/core";
import { ApiError } from "../lib/api";
import { useApi } from "../lib/ApiContext";
import type { MySecurity } from "../modules/profile/types";
import { Btn } from "../shell/components";
import { Icon } from "../shell/icons";
import { KIND_ICON } from "../shell/viz";
import { describeSubmitError, Form } from "./form";
import { Button, Dialog, Field, inputClass } from "./ui";

/** `GET /me/security`'s cache key, shared with the security page. */
export const MY_SECURITY_KEY = "my-security";

/** The person closed the confirmation: the request was not sent again, and nothing changed. */
export class StepUpCancelled extends Error {
  constructor() {
    super(translate("components.stepUp.cancelled"));
    this.name = "StepUpCancelled";
  }
}

/** The server's 403 `step_up_required` (Task 6), with the code at the top of the body or in `detail`. */
export function isStepUpRequired(error: unknown): boolean {
  if (!(error instanceof ApiError) || error.status !== 403) return false;
  let body: unknown;
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(error.message);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
  if (typeof body !== "object" || body === null) return false;
  const { code, detail } = body as { code?: unknown; detail?: unknown };
  if (code === "step_up_required") return true;
  return typeof detail === "object" && detail !== null && (detail as { code?: unknown }).code === "step_up_required";
}

/**
 * What a passkey ceremony that failed means to the person. The browser's
 * `NotAllowedError` (or `AbortError`) is a cancelled or timed-out prompt --
 * `@simplewebauthn/browser` 14 keeps the browser's `name` on its own
 * `WebAuthnError` (`helpers/webAuthnError.ts`) -- and is said plainly; a refusal
 * from the server is the server's own words; anything else names the
 * browser's reason.
 */
export function describeWebAuthnFailure(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof StepUpCancelled) return error.message;
  if (error instanceof ApiError) return describeSubmitError(error);
  if (error instanceof Error && (error.name === "NotAllowedError" || error.name === "AbortError")) {
    return translate("components.stepUp.passkeyCancelled");
  }
  const reason = error instanceof Error && error.message.trim() ? error.message : translate("validation.unexplained");
  return translate("components.stepUp.passkeyFailed", { reason });
}

/** Send `action`; on 403 `step_up_required`, confirm the second factor and send it once more. */
export type StepUpRun = <T>(action: () => Promise<T>) => Promise<T>;

export interface StepUp {
  run: StepUpRun;
  /** The dialog is open: a dialog under it is not dismissible meanwhile. */
  open: boolean;
  /** Rendered by the caller, outside any form. */
  dialog: ReactNode;
}

interface Waiter {
  resolve: () => void;
  reject: (reason: unknown) => void;
}

export function useStepUp(): StepUp {
  const waiters = useRef<Waiter[]>([]);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const settle = useCallback((confirmed: boolean) => {
    const pending = waiters.current;
    waiters.current = [];
    setOpen(false);
    for (const waiter of pending) {
      if (confirmed) waiter.resolve();
      else waiter.reject(new StepUpCancelled());
    }
  }, []);

  // A page left while the dialog waits: whatever was waiting ends, cancelled,
  // rather than holding a mutation pending for ever.
  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      const pending = waiters.current;
      waiters.current = [];
      for (const waiter of pending) waiter.reject(new StepUpCancelled());
    },
    [],
  );

  const run: StepUpRun = useCallback(async <T,>(action: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
    try {
      return await action();
    } catch (error) {
      if (!isStepUpRequired(error)) throw error;
      await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        waiters.current.push({ resolve, reject });
        setOpen(true);
      });
      // ONCE. A second refusal is the server's answer, and it is returned.
      return action();
    }
  }, []);

  return {
    run,
    open,
    dialog: <StepUpDialog open={open} onConfirmed={() => settle(true)} onCancel={() => settle(false)} />,
  };
}

function StepUpDialog({
  open,
  onConfirmed,
  onCancel,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onConfirmed: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useT();
  const api = useApi();
  const security = useQuery<MySecurity, ApiError>({
    queryKey: [MY_SECURITY_KEY],
    queryFn: () => api.getMySecurity(),
    enabled: open,
    retry: false,
  });
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [recovery, setRecovery] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setCode("");
    setRecovery("");
    setFailure(null);
    setBusy(false);
  }, [open]);

  async function attempt(confirm: () => Promise<void>, describe: (error: unknown) => string = describeSubmitError) {
    setBusy(true);
    setFailure(null);
    try {
      await confirm();
      setCode("");
      setRecovery("");
      onConfirmed();
    } catch (error) {
      setFailure(describe(error));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const data = security.data;
  const hasPasskey = (data?.passkeys.length ?? 0) > 0;
  const hasTotp = data?.has_totp === true;
  const codesLeft = data?.recovery_codes_left ?? 0;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onClose={onCancel} title={t("components.stepUp.title")}>
      <p style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>{t("components.stepUp.body")}</p>
      {security.isLoading ? <p className="note">{t("components.stepUp.loading")}</p> : null}
      {security.error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="notice red">
          <Icon name={KIND_ICON.crit} size={16} />
          <span>{describeSubmitError(security.error)}</span>
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {hasPasskey ? (
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Btn
            label={t("components.stepUp.usePasskey")}
            icon="key"
            variant="primary"
            disabled={busy}
            onClick={() =>
              void attempt(async () => {
                const optionsJSON = await api.stepUpPasskeyOptions();
                const credential = await startAuthentication({ optionsJSON });
                await api.stepUpPasskey(credential);
              }, describeWebAuthnFailure)
            }
          />
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {hasTotp ? (
        <Form onSubmit={() => void attempt(() => api.stepUpTotp(code.replace(/\s+/g, "")))}>
          <div className="form-grid">
            <Field label={t("components.stepUp.code")}>
              <input
                className={inputClass}
                value={code}
                inputMode="numeric"
                autoComplete="one-time-code"
                maxLength={12}
                disabled={busy}
                onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value)}
              />
            </Field>
          </div>
          <div className="form-actions">
            <Btn
              type="submit"
              icon="check"
              variant={hasPasskey ? "secondary" : "primary"}
              label={t("components.stepUp.confirm")}
              disabled={busy || code.trim() === ""}
            />
          </div>
        </Form>
      ) : null}
      {codesLeft > 0 ? (
        <details style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          <summary className="note cursor-pointer">{t("components.stepUp.useRecovery")}</summary>
          <Form onSubmit={() => void attempt(() => api.stepUpRecovery(recovery.trim()))}>
            <div className="form-grid">
              <Field label={t("components.stepUp.recoveryCode")} help={t("components.stepUp.recoveryHelp", { count: codesLeft })}>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={recovery}
                  autoComplete="off"
                  spellCheck={false}
                  disabled={busy}
                  onChange={(event) => setRecovery(event.target.value)}
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="form-actions">
              <Btn
                type="submit"
                label={t("components.stepUp.confirmRecovery")}
                disabled={busy || recovery.trim() === ""}
              />
            </div>
          </Form>
        </details>
      ) : null}
      {data && !hasPasskey && !hasTotp && codesLeft === 0 ? (
        <p className="note">{t("components.stepUp.noMethod")}</p>
      ) : null}
      {failure ? (
        <p role="alert" className="notice red" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <Icon name={KIND_ICON.crit} size={16} />
          <span>{failure}</span>
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="form-actions">
        <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onCancel}>
          {t("common.actions.cancel")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

Crear `frontend/src/modules/profile/SecurityPage.test.tsx`:

```tsx
/**
 * Your security -- `/profile/security` (own authentication design §2.1-§2.6).
 *
 * WHAT THIS FILE HOLDS THE PAGE TO. Each change goes to its own route and only
 * there; the second factor is asked again when -- and only when -- the server
 * says the last confirmation is stale; the console's own checks on a new
 * password say so before the round trip and never stand in for the server's
 * refusal; and the values shown once (the authenticator key, new recovery
 * codes) are on screen only until the person says they have them. The page
 * renders named fields of `GET /me/security`, never the response, so a field a
 * server should not have sent is not drawn.
 */

import { screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { ApiError } from "../../lib/api";
import {
  CREATION_OPTIONS_FIXTURE,
  MY_SECURITY_FIXTURE,
  OTPAUTH_URI_FIXTURE,
  PLANTED_SECRET,
  RECOVERY_CODES_FIXTURE,
  apiClient,
  calls,
  installDefaults,
  renderSecurityPage,
  stepUpRequired,
} from "../settings/__tests__/harness";
import { totpKeyOf } from "./SecurityPage";

const { startRegistration, startAuthentication } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  startRegistration: vi.fn(),
  startAuthentication: vi.fn(),
}));
vi.mock("@simplewebauthn/browser", () => ({ startRegistration, startAuthentication }));
vi.mock("../../lib/ApiContext", () => ({ useApi: () => apiClient() }));

/** What `startRegistration` hands back: the browser's answer, as W3C JSON. */
const ATTESTATION = {
  id: "bmV3",
  rawId: "bmV3",
  response: { clientDataJSON: "e30", attestationObject: "YXR0" },
  clientExtensionResults: {},
  type: "public-key",
};

const PASSWORD = { current: "an old phrase of mine", new: "correct horse battery staple" };

beforeEach(() => {
  installDefaults();
  startRegistration.mockReset();
  startAuthentication.mockReset();
  startRegistration.mockResolvedValue(ATTESTATION);
});

/** One panel of the page, found by its title. */
async function panel(title: string): Promise<HTMLElement> {
  const heading = await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: title });
  const section = heading.closest("section");
  if (!section) throw new Error(`no panel titled ${title}`);
  return section;
}

async function typePassword(user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>, box: HTMLElement, next = PASSWORD.new) {
  await user.type(within(box).getByLabelText("Current password"), PASSWORD.current);
  await user.type(within(box).getByLabelText("New password"), next);
  await user.type(within(box).getByLabelText("New password again"), next);
  await user.click(within(box).getByRole("button", { name: "Change password" }));
}

describe("Your security", () => {
  it("says it is loading rather than drawing empty lists", async () => {
    calls.getMySecurity.mockReturnValue(new Promise(() => {}));
    renderSecurityPage();
    expect(await screen.findByText("Loading…")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("heading", { name: "Passkeys" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("says why it did not load", async () => {
    calls.getMySecurity.mockRejectedValue(new ApiError(503, ""));
    renderSecurityPage();
    expect(await screen.findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(/unavailable/i);
  });

  it("shows the factors, the codes left, the remembered devices and the sessions it was given, and nothing else", async () => {
    renderSecurityPage();
    const passkeys = await panel("Passkeys");
    expect(within(passkeys).getByText("Work laptop")).toBeInTheDocument();
    const phone = within(passkeys).getByText("Phone").closest("li") as HTMLElement;
    expect(within(phone).getByText("Synced")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(await panel("Authenticator app")).getByText("Set up")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(await panel("Recovery codes")).getByText("8 of 10 left")).toBeInTheDocument();

    const devices = await panel("Remembered devices");
    const here = within(devices).getByText("Firefox on Windows").closest("li") as HTMLElement;
    expect(within(here).getByText("This device")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(devices).getByRole("button", { name: "Forget Safari on macOS" })).toBeInTheDocument();

    const sessions = await panel("Sessions");
    const current = within(sessions).getByText(/Firefox\/140\.0/).closest("li") as HTMLElement;
    expect(within(current).getByText("This session")).toBeInTheDocument();
    // This session ends by signing out, never from the list.
    expect(within(current).queryByRole("button")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(sessions).getByRole("button", { name: "Sign out the session from 10.0.0.9" })).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(document.body.textContent).not.toContain(PLANTED_SECRET);
  });

  it("changes the password through its own route, and empties every box once the server answered", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    const password = await panel("Password");
    await typePassword(user, password);

    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.changePassword).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(calls.changePassword).toHaveBeenCalledWith(PASSWORD);
    expect(await within(password).findByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent("Your password was changed.");
    for (const label of ["Current password", "New password", "New password again"]) {
      expect(within(password).getByLabelText<HTMLInputElement>(label)).toHaveValue("");
    }
  });

  it("refuses a short new password, and two that differ, before the round trip", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    const password = await panel("Password");
    await typePassword(user, password, "too short");
    expect(await within(password).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent("The new password needs at least 12 characters.");

    await user.clear(within(password).getByLabelText("New password"));
    await user.type(within(password).getByLabelText("New password"), PASSWORD.new);
    await user.click(within(password).getByRole("button", { name: "Change password" }));
    expect(await within(password).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent("The two new passwords are not the same.");
    expect(calls.changePassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("counts each character once, the way the server does, and takes a pasted password", async () => {
    // Six keys are twelve UTF-16 units and six characters: `.length` would let
    // this through; the server would refuse it.
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    const password = await panel("Password");
    await user.type(within(password).getByLabelText("Current password"), PASSWORD.current);
    for (const label of ["New password", "New password again"]) {
      await user.click(within(password).getByLabelText(label));
      await user.paste("🔑🔑🔑🔑🔑🔑");
    }
    await user.click(within(password).getByRole("button", { name: "Change password" }));
    expect(await within(password).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent("The new password needs at least 12 characters.");
    expect(within(password).getByText("6 characters")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(calls.changePassword).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("shows the server's own reason when it refuses the new password", async () => {
    calls.changePassword.mockRejectedValue(
      new ApiError(422, JSON.stringify({ detail: "That password is on the list attackers try first. Choose another." })),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    const password = await panel("Password");
    await typePassword(user, password);
    expect(await within(password).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(
      "That password is on the list attackers try first. Choose another.",
    );
    expect(within(password).queryByRole("status")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("asks for the second factor again when the server says the last confirmation is stale, then changes the password", async () => {
    calls.changePassword.mockRejectedValueOnce(stepUpRequired()).mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined);
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    const password = await panel("Password");
    await typePassword(user, password);

    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Confirm it's you" });
    await user.type(await within(dialog).findByLabelText("Code from your authenticator app"), "123456");
    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm" }));

    expect(await within(password).findByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent("Your password was changed.");
    expect(calls.stepUpTotp).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith("123456");
    expect(calls.changePassword).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(calls.changePassword.mock.calls[1]?.[0]).toEqual(PASSWORD);
  });

  it("adds a passkey: the server's options to the browser, the browser's answer back, under the name given", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    const passkeys = await panel("Passkeys");
    await user.type(within(passkeys).getByLabelText("Name for the new passkey"), "Desk key");
    await user.click(within(passkeys).getByRole("button", { name: "Add a passkey" }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.enrollPasskey).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(startRegistration).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith({ optionsJSON: CREATION_OPTIONS_FIXTURE });
    expect(calls.enrollPasskey).toHaveBeenCalledWith(ATTESTATION, "Desk key");
    // What the page shows next is what the server holds after the write.
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.getMySecurity).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
    expect(within(passkeys).getByLabelText<HTMLInputElement>("Name for the new passkey")).toHaveValue("");
  });

  it("changes nothing when the person cancels the browser's passkey prompt, and says so", async () => {
    startRegistration.mockRejectedValue(
      Object.assign(new Error("The operation either timed out or was not allowed."), { name: "NotAllowedError" }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    const passkeys = await panel("Passkeys");
    await user.type(within(passkeys).getByLabelText("Name for the new passkey"), "Desk key");
    await user.click(within(passkeys).getByRole("button", { name: "Add a passkey" }));

    expect(await within(passkeys).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(
      "The passkey prompt was cancelled or timed out. Nothing was changed.",
    );
    expect(calls.enrollPasskey).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("says a passkey already on the account is already there", async () => {
    startRegistration.mockRejectedValue(
      Object.assign(new Error("The authenticator was previously registered"), {
        name: "InvalidStateError",
        code: "ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_PREVIOUSLY_REGISTERED",
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    const passkeys = await panel("Passkeys");
    await user.type(within(passkeys).getByLabelText("Name for the new passkey"), "Desk key");
    await user.click(within(passkeys).getByRole("button", { name: "Add a passkey" }));
    expect(await within(passkeys).findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent("That passkey is already on your account.");
  });

  it("removes a passkey once the confirmation names it", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderSecurityPage();
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Remove the passkey Work laptop" }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: "Remove passkey" });
    expect(within(dialog).getByText("Work laptop")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(calls.removePasskey).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await user.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove passkey" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.removePasskey).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith("pk-1"));
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.getMySecurity).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2));
  });

  it("does not offer to remove the only second factor, and says why", async () => {
    calls.getMySecurity.mockResolvedValue({ ...MY_SECURITY_FIXTURE, has_totp: false, passkeys: [MY_SECURITY_FIXTURE.passkeys[0]] });
    renderSecurityPage();
    const passkeys = await panel("Passkeys");
    expect(within(passkeys).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove the passkey Work laptop" })).toBeDisabled();
    expect(within(passkeys).getByText("This is your only second factor. Add another before you remove it.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("sets up the app: the key and the link shown, the code confirmed, then the key gone", async () => {
    calls.getMySecurity.mockResolvedValue({ ...MY_SECURITY_FIXTURE, has_totp: false });

    expect(within(app).getByText("Not set up")).toBeInTheDocument();

    expect(calls.removePasskey).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
```

```ts
/**
 * THE PROFILE'S FIELDS FOLD TO ONE COLUMN ON A HANDSET.
 *
 * `.form-grid` WAS `repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))` at every width: the rule meant
 * to fold it lived in `shell.css` and lost on import order to the
 * unconditional rule in `components.css`. So at 390px "Display name" / "Phone"
 * and "Timezone" / "Locale" stayed two-up at about 148px each. Reflow at that
 * width is SC 1.4.10. The kit rule has since landed and folds every
 * `.form-grid` at 640px; this one stays because it does more than fold.
 *
 * `auto-fit` counts the columns from the space available rather than from a
 * breakpoint: two while each can hold 260px, one below. `min(100%, 260px)`
 * keeps the single column from overflowing a container narrower than the
 * minimum. The 560px ceiling is `.field`'s own `max-width`, so a pair of
 * fields is no wider than one field standing alone.
 *
 * Shared by the two pages of this module -- your profile and your security --
 * and by no other module: a module does not reach into another for a style,
 * and the kit is where the one copy belongs once it lands there.
 */
export const FOLDING_FORM_GRID = {
  gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr))",
  maxWidth: 560,
} as const;
```

Crear `frontend/src/modules/profile/api.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The reads and writes of your security page (`SecurityPage.tsx`), through
 * `useApi()` like every module.
 *
 * EVERY WRITE GOES THROUGH THE PAGE'S `useStepUp().run`, which answers the
 * server's 403 `step_up_required` (own authentication design §2.5) by asking
 * for the second factor and sending the request once more. EVERY WRITE THAT
 * CHANGES WHAT THE PAGE SHOWS re-reads `GET /me/security`: the page shows what
 * the server holds after the write, never what was typed.
 *
 * The answers that carry a value shown once (the authenticator key, new
 * recovery codes) are not cached here: the page moves them into its own state
 * and empties the mutation.
 */

import { startRegistration } from "@simplewebauthn/browser";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";

import { MY_SECURITY_KEY, type StepUpRun } from "../../components/stepUp";
import type { ApiError } from "../../lib/api";
import { useApi } from "../../lib/ApiContext";
import type { MySecurity, PasswordChange, RecoveryCodesOut } from "./types";

export function useMySecurity() {
  const api = useApi();
  return useQuery<MySecurity, ApiError>({
    queryKey: [MY_SECURITY_KEY],
    queryFn: () => api.getMySecurity(),
    retry: false,
  });
}

function useRefetchSecurity(): () => void {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return () => void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [MY_SECURITY_KEY] });
}

/** A password change also forgets the remembered devices (design §2.6), so the page re-reads. */
export function useChangePasswordMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  const refetch = useRefetchSecurity();
  return useMutation<void, Error, PasswordChange>({
    mutationFn: (body) => run(() => api.changePassword(body)),
    onSuccess: refetch,
  });
}

/**
 * Add a passkey (design §2.2): the server's creation options -- user
 * verification required, the person's own passkeys excluded (Task 5) -- to
 * the browser, and the browser's answer back under the name given. Both
 * requests may need the recent confirmation; the browser's prompt between them
 * is the person's.
 */
export function useAddPasskeyMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  const refetch = useRefetchSecurity();
  return useMutation<void, Error, { name: string }>({
    mutationFn: async ({ name }) => {
      const optionsJSON = await run(() => api.enrollPasskeyOptions());
      const credential = await startRegistration({ optionsJSON });
      await run(() => api.enrollPasskey(credential, name));
    },
    onSuccess: refetch,
  });
}

export function useRemovePasskeyMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  const refetch = useRefetchSecurity();
  return useMutation<void, Error, string>({
    mutationFn: (passkeyId) => run(() => api.removePasskey(passkeyId)),
    onSuccess: refetch,
  });
}

/** The first half of setting up the app: the server makes a key and answers with its `otpauth://` address. */
export function useStartTotpMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  return useMutation<{ otpauth_uri: string }, Error, void>({
    mutationFn: () => run(() => api.enrollTotpStart()),
  });
}

/** The second half: a code the app shows proves the key arrived; with the app already set up, it replaces it. */
export function useConfirmTotpMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  const refetch = useRefetchSecurity();
  return useMutation<void, Error, string>({
    mutationFn: async (code) => {
      await run(() => api.enrollTotpConfirm(code));
    },
    onSuccess: refetch,
  });
}

export function useRemoveTotpMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  const refetch = useRefetchSecurity();
  return useMutation<void, Error, void>({
    mutationFn: () => run(() => api.removeTotp()),
    onSuccess: refetch,
  });
}

export function useRegenerateRecoveryCodesMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  const refetch = useRefetchSecurity();
  return useMutation<RecoveryCodesOut, Error, void>({
    mutationFn: () => run(() => api.regenerateRecoveryCodes()),
    onSuccess: refetch,
  });
}

export function useRevokeTrustedDeviceMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  const refetch = useRefetchSecurity();
  return useMutation<void, Error, string>({
    mutationFn: (deviceId) => run(() => api.revokeTrustedDevice(deviceId)),
    onSuccess: refetch,
  });
}

export function useEndMySessionMutation(run: StepUpRun) {
  const api = useApi();
  const refetch = useRefetchSecurity();
  return useMutation<void, Error, string>({
    mutationFn: (sessionId) => run(() => api.endMySession(sessionId)),
    onSuccess: refetch,
  });
}
```

Crear `frontend/src/modules/profile/SecurityPage.tsx`:

```tsx
// Your security -- `/profile/security` (own authentication design §2.1-§2.6).
//
// WHAT THIS PAGE REPLACES. `/profile` carried three buttons that left the
// console for the identity provider's own pages, one sign-in step each. The
// platform is its own identity provider now (design §1.1), so the steps are
// here, as forms over the platform's routes:
//
//   GET    /me/security                                        what this page shows
//   PUT    /me/password                                        change the password
//   POST   /auth/enroll/passkey/options, /auth/enroll/passkey  add a passkey
//   DELETE /me/passkeys/{id}                                   remove one
//   POST   /auth/enroll/totp/start, /auth/enroll/totp/confirm  set up the app, or move it
//   DELETE /me/totp                                            remove the app
//   POST   /me/recovery-codes                                  ten new codes, shown once
//   DELETE /me/trusted-devices/{id}                            forget a remembered device
//   DELETE /me/sessions/{id}                                   sign out another session
//
// THE SERVER DECIDES EVERYTHING (invariant 6). The password bounds restated in
// the form (12 to 128 characters, each code point one) only save a round trip;
// the blocklist, the context words and the bounds are the server's (§2.1), and
// its refusal is shown in its own words. Removing the last second factor is
// refused by the server; the console only says so before the click. A change
// that needs the second factor confirmed in the last 10 minutes (§2.5) is the
// server's 403 `step_up_required`, answered through `useStepUp`.
//
// NOTHING SECRET IS KEPT (invariant 3). The password boxes are emptied once the
// server has answered. The authenticator key and new recovery codes are the
// values a person must see once: each is held in this component's state only
// -- the mutation that brought it is emptied at once, so it sits in no cache --
// and is gone when the person says they have it. The page renders named
// fields of `GET /me/security`, never the response, so a field a server should
// not have sent is not drawn.
//
// A BROWSER MAY REFUSE A PASSKEY PROMPT THAT DID NOT FOLLOW A CLICK (Safari
// can), which is what happens when the second factor had to be confirmed
// first: the failure says the prompt was cancelled and nothing changed, and
// clicking "Add a passkey" again works, because the confirmation is now fresh.

import { useState, type CSSProperties } from "react";

import { ConfirmDialog } from "../../components/confirm";
import { describeSubmitError, Form } from "../../components/form";
import { describeWebAuthnFailure, useStepUp, type StepUpRun } from "../../components/stepUp";
import { Badge, Field, inputClass } from "../../components/ui";
import { useT } from "../../i18n/context";
import type { MessageKey } from "../../i18n/core";
import { describeWhen, formatDate } from "../../lib/datetime";
import { useOrgZone } from "../../lib/zone";
import { Btn, KIND_ICON, PageHead, Panel } from "../../shell/components";
import { Icon } from "../../shell/icons";
import {
  useAddPasskeyMutation,
  useChangePasswordMutation,
  useConfirmTotpMutation,
  useEndMySessionMutation,
  useMySecurity,
  useRegenerateRecoveryCodesMutation,
  useRemovePasskeyMutation,
  useRemoveTotpMutation,
  useRevokeTrustedDeviceMutation,
  useStartTotpMutation,
} from "./api";
import { FOLDING_FORM_GRID } from "./layout";
import {
  PASSWORD_MAX,
  PASSWORD_MIN,
  RECOVERY_CODE_COUNT,
  type MyPasskey,
  type MySecurity,
  type MySession,
  type MyTrustedDevice,
} from "./types";

const LIST: CSSProperties = { listStyle: "none", margin: 0, padding: 0, display: "grid", gap: 10 };
const ROW: CSSProperties = { display: "flex", flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px 12px" };
const ROW_TEXT: CSSProperties = { flex: "1 1 240px", minWidth: 0 };
/** A browser's own string or a key has no spaces to break at; at 390px it must still wrap. */
const WRAP_ANYWHERE: CSSProperties = { overflowWrap: "anywhere" };

/** `otpauth://totp/…?secret=ABCD…` -> "ABCD EFGH …": the key in groups of four, to type into an app. */
export function totpKeyOf(uri: string): string {
  try {
    const secret = new URL(uri).searchParams.get("secret") ?? "";
    return secret.replace(/(.{4})/g, "$1 ").trim();
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/**
 * Copying without swallowing the failure (the pattern of
 * `enrollment/EnrollmentPage.tsx:254-270`): a copy that fails silently would
 * let a person dismiss the only copy of their codes believing they had it.
 */
async function copyToClipboard(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** A refusal held as data, so a change of language re-words it. */
interface Refusal {
  key: MessageKey;
  vars?: Record<string, number>;
}

function Failure({ message }: { message: string }) {
  return (
    <p role="alert" className="notice red" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
      <Icon name={KIND_ICON.crit} size={16} />
      <span>{message}</span>
    </p>
  );
}

/** `@simplewebauthn/browser`'s code for a passkey the account already holds. */
function isAlreadyRegistered(error: unknown): boolean {
  return (
    typeof error === "object" &&
    error !== null &&
    (error as { code?: unknown }).code === "ERROR_AUTHENTICATOR_PREVIOUSLY_REGISTERED"
  );
}

export function SecurityPage() {
  const t = useT();
  const security = useMySecurity();
  const stepUp = useStepUp();
  const zone = useOrgZone();
  const data = security.data;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHead title={t("profile.securityPage.title")} description={t("profile.securityPage.description")} />
      {security.isLoading ? (
        <Panel>
          <p className="note">{t("profile.securityPage.loading")}</p>
        </Panel>
      ) : security.error ? (
        <Panel>
          <p role="alert" className="notice red">
            <Icon name={KIND_ICON.crit} size={16} />
            <span>{describeSubmitError(security.error)}</span>
          </p>
        </Panel>
      ) : data ? (
        <>
          <PasswordPanel run={stepUp.run} />
          <PasskeysPanel security={data} run={stepUp.run} zone={zone} />
          <TotpPanel security={data} run={stepUp.run} />
          <RecoveryPanel security={data} run={stepUp.run} />
          <DevicesPanel security={data} run={stepUp.run} zone={zone} />
          <SessionsPanel security={data} run={stepUp.run} zone={zone} />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {stepUp.dialog}
    </>
  );
}

function PasswordPanel({ run }: { run: StepUpRun }) {
  const t = useT();
  const change = useChangePasswordMutation(run);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState("");
  const [next, setNext] = useState("");
  const [repeat, setRepeat] = useState("");
  const [refusal, setRefusal] = useState<Refusal | null>(null);
  // Each code point is one character, as the server counts them (design §2.1).
  const length = [...next].length;

  function submit() {
    change.reset();
    const found: Refusal | null =
      current === ""
        ? { key: "profile.securityPage.password.missingCurrent" }
        : length < PASSWORD_MIN
          ? { key: "profile.securityPage.password.tooShort", vars: { min: PASSWORD_MIN } }
          : length > PASSWORD_MAX
            ? { key: "profile.securityPage.password.tooLong", vars: { max: PASSWORD_MAX } }
            : next !== repeat
              ? { key: "profile.securityPage.password.mismatch" }
              : null;
    setRefusal(found);
    if (found) return;
    change.mutate(
      { current, new: next },
      {
        // Whatever the server answered, the boxes are emptied: a password is
        // typed again rather than kept on the page.
        onSettled: () => {
          setCurrent("");
          setNext("");
          setRepeat("");
        },
      },
    );
  }

  return (
    <Panel title={t("profile.securityPage.password.title")} subtitle={t("profile.securityPage.password.subtitle")}>
      <Form onSubmit={submit}>
        <div className="form-grid" style={FOLDING_FORM_GRID}>
          <Field label={t("profile.securityPage.password.current")}>
            <input
              className={inputClass}
              type="password"
              autoComplete="current-password"
              value={current}
              onChange={(event) => setCurrent(event.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field
            label={t("profile.securityPage.password.next")}
            help={t("profile.securityPage.password.length", { count: length })}
          >
            <input
              className={inputClass}
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              value={next}
              onChange={(event) => setNext(event.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
          <Field label={t("profile.securityPage.password.repeat")}>
            <input
              className={inputClass}
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              value={repeat}
              onChange={(event) => setRepeat(event.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Btn
            type="submit"
            variant="primary"
            icon="lock"
            label={change.isPending ? t("profile.securityPage.password.changing") : t("profile.securityPage.password.submit")}
            disabled={change.isPending}
          />
          {refusal ? (
            <span role="alert" className="form-error">
              <Icon name={KIND_ICON.crit} size={13} />
              {t(refusal.key, refusal.vars)}
            </span>
          ) : null}
          {change.error ? (
            <span role="alert" className="form-error">
              <Icon name={KIND_ICON.crit} size={13} />
              {describeSubmitError(change.error)}
            </span>
          ) : null}
          {change.isSuccess ? (
            <span role="status" className="form-saved">
              <Icon name={KIND_ICON.ok} size={13} />
              {t("profile.securityPage.password.changed")}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </Form>
    </Panel>
  );
}

function PasskeysPanel({ security, run, zone }: { security: MySecurity; run: StepUpRun; zone: string | null }) {
  const t = useT();
  const add = useAddPasskeyMutation(run);
  const remove = useRemovePasskeyMutation(run);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<MyPasskey | null>(null);
  // The server refuses removing the last second factor; this only says so first.
  const onlyFactor = security.passkeys.length + (security.has_totp ? 1 : 0) <= 1;
  const addFailure = add.error
    ? isAlreadyRegistered(add.error)
      ? t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.duplicate")
      : describeWebAuthnFailure(add.error)
    : null;

  return (
    <Panel title={t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.title")} subtitle={t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.subtitle")}>
      {security.passkeys.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="note">{t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.empty")}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul style={LIST}>
          {security.passkeys.map((passkey) => (
            <li key={passkey.id} style={ROW}>
              <div style={ROW_TEXT}>
                <div className="cell-title">
                  {passkey.name}
                  {passkey.backup_state ? (
                    <>
                      {" "}
                      <Badge variant="info">{t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.synced")}</Badge>
                    </>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                <div className="cell-sub">
                  {`${t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.added", { when: describeWhen(passkey.created_at, undefined, zone) })} · ${
                    passkey.last_used_at
                      ? t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.lastUsed", { when: describeWhen(passkey.last_used_at, undefined, zone) })
                      : t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.neverUsed")
                  }`}
                </div>
              </div>
              <Btn
                small
                icon="trash"
                label={t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.remove")}
                ariaLabel={t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.removeAria", { name: passkey.name })}
                disabled={onlyFactor || remove.isPending}
                title={onlyFactor ? t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.onlyFactor") : undefined}
                onClick={() => setRemoving(passkey)}
              />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {onlyFactor && security.passkeys.length === 1 ? (
        <p className="note" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          {t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.onlyFactor")}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {remove.error ? <Failure message={describeSubmitError(remove.error)} /> : null}

      <Form onSubmit={() => add.mutate({ name: name.trim() }, { onSuccess: () => setName("") })}>
        <div className="form-grid" style={{ ...FOLDING_FORM_GRID, marginTop: 14 }}>
          <Field label={t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.name")}>
            <input
              className={inputClass}
              value={name}
              placeholder={t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.namePlaceholder")}
              onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
        </div>
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Btn
            type="submit"
            icon="key"
            label={add.isPending ? t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.adding") : t("profile.securityPage.passkeys.add")}
            disabled={add.isPending || name.trim() === ""}
          />
        </div>
      </Form>
      {addFailure ? <Failure message={addFailure} /> : null}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={removing !== null}
        title={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.passkey.title")}
        body={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.passkey.body")}
        subject={removing?.name ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.passkey.action")}
        destructive
        onConfirm={() => {
          const target = removing;
          setRemoving(null);
          if (target) remove.mutate(target.id);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setRemoving(null)}
      />
    </Panel>
  );
}

function TotpPanel({ security, run }: { security: MySecurity; run: StepUpRun }) {
  const t = useT();
  const start = useStartTotpMutation(run);
  const confirm = useConfirmTotpMutation(run);
  const remove = useRemoveTotpMutation(run);
  // The `otpauth://` address while a set-up is open: the one place the key is.
  const [setupUri, setSetupUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  const onlyFactor = security.has_totp && security.passkeys.length === 0;

  function begin() {
    confirm.reset();
    start.mutate(undefined, {
      onSuccess: (out) => {
        setSetupUri(out.otpauth_uri);
        setCode("");
        // The key is in this component's state now, and nowhere else.
        start.reset();
      },
    });
  }

  function finish() {
    confirm.mutate(code.replace(/\s+/g, ""), {
      onSuccess: () => {
        setSetupUri(null);
        setCode("");
      },
    });
  }

  function cancel() {
    setSetupUri(null);
    setCode("");
    confirm.reset();
  }

  return (
    <Panel
      title={t("profile.securityPage.totp.title")}
      subtitle={t("profile.securityPage.totp.subtitle")}
      actions={
        <Badge variant={security.has_totp ? "success" : "muted"}>
          {security.has_totp ? t("profile.securityPage.totp.on") : t("profile.securityPage.totp.off")}
        </Badge>
      }
    >
      {setupUri ? (
        <>
          <p className="note">{t("profile.securityPage.totp.instructions")}</p>
          {security.has_totp ? (
            <p className="note" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              {t("profile.securityPage.totp.replaceNote")}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {/* Only an authenticator address is a link: a server that answered
              anything else gets the key alone. */}
          {setupUri.startsWith("otpauth://") ? (
            <div className="form-actions">
              <a className="btn small" href={setupUri}>
                <Icon name="link" size={14} />
                <span>{t("profile.securityPage.totp.open")}</span>
              </a>
            </div>
          ) : null}
          <p style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            <span className="k">{t("profile.securityPage.totp.key")}</span>{" "}
            <code className="code" style={WRAP_ANYWHERE}>
              {totpKeyOf(setupUri)}
            </code>
          </p>
          <Form onSubmit={finish}>
            <div className="form-grid" style={{ ...FOLDING_FORM_GRID, marginTop: 10 }}>
              <Field label={t("profile.securityPage.totp.code")}>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={code}
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  autoComplete="one-time-code"
                  maxLength={12}
                  onChange={(event) => setCode(event.target.value)}
                />
              </Field>
            </div>
            <div className="form-actions">
              <Btn
                type="submit"
                variant="primary"
                icon="check"
                label={confirm.isPending ? t("profile.securityPage.totp.confirming") : t("profile.securityPage.totp.confirm")}
                disabled={confirm.isPending || code.trim() === ""}
              />
              <Btn label={t("profile.securityPage.totp.cancel")} onClick={cancel} />
            </div>
          </Form>
          {confirm.error ? <Failure message={describeSubmitError(confirm.error)} /> : null}
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="form-actions">
          <Btn
            icon="shield-lock"
            variant={security.has_totp ? "secondary" : "primary"}
            label={
              start.isPending
                ? t("profile.securityPage.totp.starting")
                : security.has_totp
                  ? t("profile.securityPage.totp.replace")
                  : t("profile.securityPage.totp.setUp")
            }
            disabled={start.isPending}
            onClick={begin}
          />
          {security.has_totp ? (
            <Btn
              icon="trash"
              label={t("profile.securityPage.totp.remove")}
              ariaLabel={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.totp.action")}
              disabled={onlyFactor || remove.isPending}
              title={onlyFactor ? t("profile.securityPage.totp.onlyFactor") : undefined}
              onClick={() => setAsking(true)}
            />
          ) : null}
        </div>
      )}
      {onlyFactor && setupUri === null ? (
        <p className="note" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          {t("profile.securityPage.totp.onlyFactor")}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {start.error ? <Failure message={describeSubmitError(start.error)} /> : null}
      {remove.error ? <Failure message={describeSubmitError(remove.error)} /> : null}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={asking}
        title={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.totp.title")}
        body={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.totp.body")}
        subject={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.totpSubject")}
        confirmLabel={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.totp.action")}
        destructive
        onConfirm={() => {
          setAsking(false);
          remove.mutate();
        }}
        onCancel={() => setAsking(false)}
      />
    </Panel>
  );
}

function RecoveryPanel({ security, run }: { security: MySecurity; run: StepUpRun }) {
  const t = useT();
  const regenerate = useRegenerateRecoveryCodesMutation(run);
  // The new codes while they are shown: the one place they exist in the clear.
  const [codes, setCodes] = useState<readonly string[] | null>(null);
  const [asking, setAsking] = useState(false);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState<"copied" | "failed" | null>(null);
  const left = security.recovery_codes_left;

  return (
    <Panel title={t("profile.securityPage.recovery.title")} subtitle={t("profile.securityPage.recovery.subtitle")}>
      {codes ? (
        <>
          <div className="notice gold" role="status">
            <Icon name={KIND_ICON.warn} size={16} />
            <span>{t("profile.securityPage.recovery.shownOnce")}</span>
          </div>
          <ol className="mono" style={{ margin: "12px 0 0", paddingLeft: 22, display: "grid", gap: 4 }}>
            {codes.map((code) => (
              <li key={code}>{code}</li>
            ))}
          </ol>
          <div className="form-actions">
            <Btn
              icon="copy"
              label={t("profile.securityPage.recovery.copy")}
              onClick={() => void copyToClipboard(codes.join("\n")).then((ok) => setCopied(ok ? "copied" : "failed"))}
            />
            <Btn
              variant="primary"
              icon="check"
              label={t("profile.securityPage.recovery.done")}
              onClick={() => {
                setCodes(null);
                setCopied(null);
              }}
            />
            {copied === "copied" ? (
              <span className="form-saved">
                <Icon name={KIND_ICON.ok} size={13} />
                {t("profile.securityPage.recovery.copied")}
              </span>
            ) : null}
            {copied === "failed" ? (
              <span role="alert" className="form-error">
                <Icon name={KIND_ICON.crit} size={13} />
                {t("profile.securityPage.recovery.copyFailed")}
              </span>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <p>{t("profile.securityPage.recovery.left", { count: left, total: RECOVERY_CODE_COUNT })}</p>
          {left <= 3 ? (
            <p className="notice gold" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
              <Icon name={KIND_ICON.warn} size={16} />
              <span>{t("profile.securityPage.recovery.low")}</span>
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <div className="form-actions">
            <Btn
              icon="refresh"
              label={regenerate.isPending ? t("profile.securityPage.recovery.regenerating") : t("profile.securityPage.recovery.regenerate")}
              disabled={regenerate.isPending}
              onClick={() => setAsking(true)}
            />
          </div>
        </>
      )}
      {regenerate.error ? <Failure message={describeSubmitError(regenerate.error)} /> : null}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={asking}
        title={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.codes.title")}
        body={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.codes.body")}
        subject={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.codesSubject", { count: left })}
        confirmLabel={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.codes.action")}
        destructive
        onConfirm={() => {
          setAsking(false);
          regenerate.mutate(undefined, {
            onSuccess: (out) => {
              setCodes(out.recovery_codes);
              setCopied(null);
              // The codes are in this component's state now, and nowhere else.
              regenerate.reset();
            },
          });
        }}
        onCancel={() => setAsking(false)}
      />
    </Panel>
  );
}

function DevicesPanel({ security, run, zone }: { security: MySecurity; run: StepUpRun; zone: string | null }) {
  const t = useT();
  const revoke = useRevokeTrustedDeviceMutation(run);
  const [forgetting, setForgetting] = useState<MyTrustedDevice | null>(null);
  const label = (device: MyTrustedDevice): string => device.label || t("profile.securityPage.devices.unnamed");

  return (
    <Panel title={t("profile.securityPage.devices.title")} subtitle={t("profile.securityPage.devices.subtitle")}>
      {security.trusted_devices.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="note">{t("profile.securityPage.devices.empty")}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul style={LIST}>
          {security.trusted_devices.map((device) => (
            <li key={device.id} style={ROW}>
              <div style={ROW_TEXT}>
                <div className="cell-title">
                  {label(device)}
                  {device.current ? (
                    <>
                      {" "}
                      <Badge variant="info">{t("profile.securityPage.devices.thisDevice")}</Badge>
                    </>
                  ) : null}
                </div>
                <div className="cell-sub">
                  {`${t("profile.securityPage.devices.remembered", { when: describeWhen(device.created_at, undefined, zone) })} · ${t(
                    "profile.securityPage.devices.until",
                    { date: formatDate(device.expires_at, zone) },
                  )}`}
                </div>
              </div>
              <Btn
                small
                icon="unlink"
                label={t("profile.securityPage.devices.forget")}
                ariaLabel={t("profile.securityPage.devices.forgetAria", { label: label(device) })}
                disabled={revoke.isPending}
                onClick={() => setForgetting(device)}
              />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {revoke.error ? <Failure message={describeSubmitError(revoke.error)} /> : null}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={forgetting !== null}
        title={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.device.title")}
        body={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.device.body")}
        subject={forgetting ? label(forgetting) : ""}
        confirmLabel={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.device.action")}
        destructive
        onConfirm={() => {
          const target = forgetting;
          setForgetting(null);
          if (target) revoke.mutate(target.id);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setForgetting(null)}
      />
    </Panel>
  );
}

function SessionsPanel({ security, run, zone }: { security: MySecurity; run: StepUpRun; zone: string | null }) {
  const t = useT();
  const end = useEndMySessionMutation(run);
  const [ending, setEnding] = useState<MySession | null>(null);
  const browser = (session: MySession): string => session.user_agent || t("profile.securityPage.sessions.unknownBrowser");
  const where = (session: MySession): string => session.ip || browser(session);

  return (
    <Panel title={t("profile.securityPage.sessions.title")} subtitle={t("profile.securityPage.sessions.subtitle")}>
      <ul style={LIST}>
        {security.sessions.map((session) => (
          <li key={session.id} style={ROW}>
            <div style={ROW_TEXT}>
              <div className="cell-title mono" style={WRAP_ANYWHERE}>
                {browser(session)}
              </div>
              <div className="cell-sub">
                {[
                  session.ip ? t("profile.securityPage.sessions.from", { ip: session.ip }) : null,
                  t("profile.securityPage.sessions.started", { when: describeWhen(session.created_at, undefined, zone) }),
                  t("profile.securityPage.sessions.lastActive", { when: describeWhen(session.last_seen_at, undefined, zone) }),
                ]
                  .filter((part): part is string => part !== null)
                  .join(" · ")}
              </div>
            </div>
            {session.current ? (
              <Badge variant="info">{t("profile.securityPage.sessions.thisSession")}</Badge>
            ) : (
              <Btn
                small
                icon="logout"
                label={t("profile.securityPage.sessions.end")}
                ariaLabel={t("profile.securityPage.sessions.endAria", { where: where(session) })}
                disabled={end.isPending}
                onClick={() => setEnding(session)}
              />
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {end.error ? <Failure message={describeSubmitError(end.error)} /> : null}

      <ConfirmDialog
        open={ending !== null}
        title={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.session.title")}
        body={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.session.body")}
        subject={ending ? browser(ending) : ""}
        confirmLabel={t("profile.securityPage.confirm.session.action")}
        destructive
        onConfirm={() => {
          const target = ending;
          setEnding(null);
          if (target) end.mutate(target.id);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setEnding(null)}
      />
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * Your profile -- `GET/PATCH /api/v1/me`, and the way to your security.
 *
 * THE SPLIT IS THE DESIGN. This page owns how the console shows you --
 * display name, phone, timezone, locale. How you sign in -- password,
 * passkeys, the authenticator app, recovery codes, remembered devices and
 * sessions -- is one page further, at `/profile/security`.
 *
 * WHAT CHANGED, AND WHY (own authentication design §1.1, §2). These used to be
 * three buttons that started one step each at the identity provider's own
 * pages, and the tests here pinned which step each asked for and what happened
 * when one could not be started. The platform is its own identity provider
 * now: there is no second application to step into, the panel is a link
 * inside this console, and `SecurityPage.test.tsx` pins that each change calls
 * its own route.
 *
 * A 404 on `PATCH /me` renders the form disabled and says why, exactly as the
 * Organization tab does -- never an editable form that posts into the void.
 */

import { screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { ApiError } from "../../lib/api";
import {
  ALL_PERMISSIONS,
  ME_FIXTURE,
  apiClient,
  calls,
  installDefaults,
  renderProfilePage,
} from "../settings/__tests__/harness";

vi.mock("../../lib/ApiContext", () => ({ useApi: () => apiClient() }));

beforeEach(() => {
  installDefaults();
});

async function openProfile() {
  const user = userEvent.setup();
  // A ROUTE, NOT A TAB, so there is no tab to click: this used to render the
  // whole of Settings and click through to "Profile".
  renderProfilePage();
  return user;
}

describe("Your profile", () => {
  it("says it is loading rather than rendering an empty form", async () => {
    calls.me.mockReturnValue(new Promise(() => {}));
    renderProfilePage();
    // The page needs no permission — every session has a profile — so it
    // renders before `/me` answers, and says so rather than showing an empty
    // form somebody might start typing into.
    expect(await screen.findByText("Loading…")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("seeds the form from the server's own values", async () => {
    await openProfile();
    expect(await screen.findByLabelText<HTMLInputElement>("Display name")).toHaveValue("Operator");
    expect(screen.getByLabelText<HTMLInputElement>("Phone")).toHaveValue(ME_FIXTURE.phone);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText<HTMLInputElement>("Timezone")).toHaveValue(ME_FIXTURE.timezone);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText<HTMLSelectElement>("Language")).toHaveValue("en");
    expect(screen.getByText(/operator@example\.com/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("PATCHes only the four fields this route owns, and claims nothing before the server answers", async () => {
    // The re-read after the write returns what the server STORED. Leaving the
    // original fixture in place would let the form claim "Saved." over a value
    // the server never confirmed — the same reason the org tab re-seeds from
    // the PATCH response rather than from what was typed.
    const stored = { ...ME_FIXTURE, phone: "+57 601 555 0199", permissions: [...ALL_PERMISSIONS] };
    calls.me
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...ME_FIXTURE, permissions: [...ALL_PERMISSIONS] })
      .mockResolvedValue(stored);
    calls.updateMe.mockResolvedValue(stored);
    const user = await openProfile();
    const phone = await screen.findByLabelText("Phone");
    await user.clear(phone);
    await user.type(phone, "+57 601 555 0199");
    expect(calls.updateMe).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save changes" }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(calls.updateMe).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(calls.updateMe).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      display_name: "Operator",
      phone: "+57 601 555 0199",
      timezone: "America/Bogota",
      locale: "en-GB",
    });
    expect(await screen.findByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent(/Saved/);
    expect(screen.getByLabelText<HTMLInputElement>("Phone")).toHaveValue("+57 601 555 0199");
  });

  it("refuses a clean save out loud instead of presenting a dead button", async () => {
    // ONE CONTROL, ONE BEHAVIOUR, ACROSS THE GROUP. The sibling route
    // /settings draws this same `SaveBar` with `requireDirty={false}`, so its
    // "Save changes" is a live accent button that says why it will not save.
    // Here the default left a pale disabled chip -- same size, radius, icon
    // and shape as the enabled "Change password" below it, and no on-screen
    // reason it could not be pressed.
    const user = await openProfile();
    const save = await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Save changes" });
    expect(save).toBeEnabled();

    await user.click(save);
    expect(await screen.findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(/no unsaved changes/i);
    // Refused, not written: nothing reached the server.
    expect(calls.updateMe).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    // And the refusal is stale the moment there IS something to save.
    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Phone"), "9");
    expect(screen.queryByText(/no unsaved changes/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("a 404 disables the form and says why, rather than accepting typing that goes nowhere", async () => {
    calls.updateMe.mockRejectedValue(new ApiError(404, "Not Found"));
    const user = await openProfile();
    const phone = await screen.findByLabelText("Phone");
    await user.clear(phone);
    await user.type(phone, "+57 601 555 0199");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save changes" }));

    const alert = await screen.findByRole("alert");
    // THE SERVER'S OWN WORDS, not the status code (cycle 4). This asserted
    // `/404/` while the save bar printed `error.message`; the kernel's
    // `describeSubmitError` renders the body a server sent and falls back to a
    // sentence when it sent none. The property that matters is unchanged and
    // is asserted on the next line: nothing claims a save.
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent(/Not Found/);
    expect(screen.queryByRole("status")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("says why the profile did not load, rather than one sentence for every cause", async () => {
    // "That did not load. Retry, or check the platform status page." was the
    // page's answer to a 403, to a 404 on an API older than `GET /me`, and to
    // a proxy 503 alike -- three different things for the operator to do.
    calls.me.mockRejectedValue(new ApiError(403, ""));
    renderProfilePage();
    const alert = await screen.findByRole("alert");
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent(/do not have permission/i);
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText("Display name")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("offers your security page, a link inside this console", async () => {
    // RE-POINTED (own authentication design §2) from "says so when a
    // credential step cannot even be started": that test was about a step at a
    // second application that could fail to begin. There is no second
    // application; the panel is one link.
    await openProfile();
    const link = await screen.findByRole("link", { name: "Open your security" });
    expect(link).toHaveAttribute("href", "/profile/security");
  });

  it("leaves for no other application", async () => {
    // RE-POINTED from "starts the credential step in place rather than
    // opening another app": THE SEAM THE BUYER SEES was a link to an account
    // console. No anchor out of this console survives on the page.
    await openProfile();
    await screen.findByRole("link", { name: "Open your security" });
    const outward = screen.queryAllByRole("link").filter((anchor) => {
      const href = anchor.getAttribute("href") ?? "";
      return href.includes("account") || href.includes("/realms/") || /^https?:/.test(href);
    });
    expect(outward).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("never tells the reader there is a second product to go and understand", async () => {
    // Task 3's guard sweeps every source file; this one is the assertion at
    // the place the word once leaked, and at the promise this page used to
    // make that is no longer true ("never handled by this platform").
    await openProfile();
    await screen.findByRole("link", { name: "Open your security" });
    expect(document.body.textContent ?? "").not.toMatch(/keycloak/i);
    expect(document.body.textContent ?? "").not.toMatch(/account console/i);
    expect(document.body.textContent ?? "").not.toMatch(/never handled by this platform/i);
  });

  it("lets the four fields fold to one column instead of holding two at any width", async () => {
    // At 390px "Display name" / "Phone" and "Timezone" / "Locale" stayed
    // two-up at about 148px each. `auto-fit` also caps the pair at one
    // field's width in a wide panel, which no breakpoint expresses.
    await openProfile();
    const grid = (await screen.findByLabelText("Display name")).closest(".form-grid");
    expect(grid).not.toBeNull();
    const columns = (grid as HTMLElement).style.gridTemplateColumns;
    expect(columns).toContain("auto-fit");
    // A fixed two-column track is exactly what could not fold.
    expect(columns).not.toContain("repeat(2");
  });

  it("has no password field and no field for the email address", async () => {
    // RE-POINTED reason, same assertion: the password is changed on
    // `/profile/security`, behind the recent confirmation (design §2.5), not
    // in the profile's form; the address is not changed by this console.
    await openProfile();
    await screen.findByLabelText("Display name");
    expect(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="password"]')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText(/^Email/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText(/current password/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

`frontend/src/modules/profile/ProfilePage.tsx` entero:

```tsx
// Your profile -- `GET/PATCH /api/v1/me`, and the way to your security.
//
// A PAGE AT `/profile`, NOT A TAB IN SETTINGS, since 2026-08-20: it is your
// own record rather than administration, reached from the account menu
// behind your own avatar, which is where every other product puts it.
//
// THE SPLIT, NOW THAT THE PLATFORM IS ITS OWN IDENTITY PROVIDER (own
// authentication design §1.1, §2). This page edits how the console shows you
// -- display name, phone, timezone, language. How you SIGN IN -- your
// password, passkeys, authenticator app, recovery codes, remembered devices
// and sessions -- is one page further, at `/profile/security`
// (`SecurityPage.tsx`), behind the recent confirmation of the second factor
// where the design asks for it (§2.5). It used to be three buttons that left
// the console for the identity provider's own pages, one step each; there is
// no second application any more, so the panel below is a link inside this
// one.
//
// THE EMAIL ADDRESS IS NOT CHANGED HERE: a sign-in address changes through a
// re-authenticated, verified flow this console does not offer, and the note
// under the title says to ask an administrator.
//
// THE PAGE IS v3's `profile` SCREEN: the head, then one untitled panel of
// fields with the primary Save under them, then the sign-in panel with its
// one link -- a panel of its own, so the Save above it is unambiguously the
// profile's.

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";

import { describeSubmitError } from "../../components/form";
import type { Problem } from "../../components/form";
import { Field, inputClass } from "../../components/ui";
import { useLanguage, useT } from "../../i18n/context";
import { resolveLanguage } from "../../i18n/resolve";
import { KIND_ICON, PageHead, Panel } from "../../shell/components";
import { Icon } from "../../shell/icons";
import { useMe, useUpdateMeMutation } from "../settings/api";
import { SaveBar } from "../settings/SaveBar";
import { isDirty } from "../settings/settingsState";
import type { MeProfileUpdate } from "../settings/types";
import { FOLDING_FORM_GRID } from "./layout";

type ProfileForm = {
  display_name: string;
  phone: string;
  timezone: string;
  locale: string;
};

export function ProfilePage() {
  const me = useMe();
  const update = useUpdateMeMutation();
  const t = useT();
  const { language, setLanguage } = useLanguage();
  const [languagePicked, setLanguagePicked] = useState(false);

  // An ABSENT field is an empty box, never the string "undefined": a server
  // that predates migration 0066 serves no `phone`, and typing over the word
  // "undefined" is how a placeholder becomes a stored value.
  const seed: ProfileForm = {
    display_name: me.data?.display_name ?? "",
    phone: me.data?.phone ?? "",
    timezone: me.data?.timezone ?? "",
    locale: me.data?.locale ?? "",
  };
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ProfileForm>(seed);

  // Re-seed only when the SERVER'S values change — after a save, after a
  // refetch. Typing is never overwritten by a background refetch of the same
  // values. Same shape as the Organization tab, for the same reason.
  const seedSignature = JSON.stringify(seed);
  useEffect(() => {
    setForm(JSON.parse(seedSignature) as ProfileForm);
    setLanguagePicked(false);
    setRefusal([]);
  }, [seedSignature]);

  // What the select shows: the account's saved language if it is one the
  // console supports, otherwise the language the console is showing now.
  const shownLanguage = resolveLanguage(form.locale, null, language);

  const dirty = isDirty(form, seed);
  const editable = me.data != null;

  /**
   * A save this page refused, and the reason.
   *
   * **ONE CONTROL, ONE BEHAVIOUR, ACROSS THE GROUP.** This page and /settings
   * draw the same `SaveBar`, and they behaved differently: /settings passes
   * `requireDirty={false}`, so its "Save changes" is a live accent button that
   * refuses out loud; here the default left a clean form showing a pale
   * disabled chip carrying no on-screen reason it could not be pressed. This
   * page now takes the click and says why, which is rule 1's own preference
   * where the refusal is the console's rather than the server's.
   */
  const [refusal, setRefusal] = useState<Problem[]>([]);

  function submit() {
    // A save with nothing to save writes an audit entry for a change that is
    // not one, so it is still refused -- out loud, in the same words the
    // Organization tab uses.
    if (!dirty) {
      setRefusal([{ name: "display_name", message: t("profile.page.noChanges") }]);
      return;
    }
    setRefusal([]);
    // `""` is a CLEARED field, not an empty string to store: the columns are
    // nullable and "no phone number" is null.
    const blankToNull = (value: string): string | null =>
      value.trim() === "" ? null : value.trim();
    const body: MeProfileUpdate = {
      display_name: form.display_name.trim(),
      phone: blankToNull(form.phone),
      timezone: blankToNull(form.timezone),
      locale: blankToNull(form.locale),
    };
    // Only a language the PERSON picked is sent as a new value and applied.
    // An untouched field is sent exactly as it was read (a stored "en-GB"
    // stays "en-GB", a null stays null), so saving a phone number can never
    // change the language. The picked one is applied to the console once the
    // server has accepted it, without a second save: this PATCH is the save.
    if (languagePicked) body.locale = shownLanguage;
    update.mutate(body, {
      onSuccess: () => {
        if (languagePicked) setLanguage(shownLanguage, { persist: false });
      },
    });
  }

  return (
    <>
      <PageHead
        title={t("profile.page.title")}
        description={t("profile.page.description")}
      />

      <Panel>
        {me.isLoading ? (
          <p className="note">{t("profile.page.loading")}</p>
        ) : me.error ? (
          // The server's own reason (cycle 4), announced: "That did not load"
          // is the same sentence for a 403, a 404 on an API that predates
          // `GET /me`, and a proxy 503 — three different things to do next.
          <p role="alert" className="notice red">
            <Icon name={KIND_ICON.crit} size={16} />
            <span>{describeSubmitError(me.error)}</span>
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <p className="note" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
              {t("profile.page.signedInAs", { email: me.data?.email ?? "" })}
            </p>

            <div className="form-grid" style={FOLDING_FORM_GRID}>
              <Field label={t("profile.page.displayName")}>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={form.display_name}
                  disabled={!editable}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, display_name: event.target.value }))
                  }
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label={t("profile.page.phone")}>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={form.phone}
                  disabled={!editable}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, phone: event.target.value }))
                  }
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label={t("profile.page.timezone")}>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={form.timezone}
                  disabled={!editable}
                  placeholder={t("profile.page.timezonePlaceholder")}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, timezone: event.target.value }))
                  }
                />
              </Field>
              <Field label={t("common.language.label")}>
                <select
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={shownLanguage}
                  disabled={!editable}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    setLanguagePicked(true);
                    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, locale: event.target.value }));
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="en">{t("common.language.english")}</option>
                  <option value="es">{t("common.language.spanish")}</option>
                </select>
              </Field>
            </div>

            <p className="note" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
              {t("profile.page.smsNote")}
            </p>

            <SaveBar
              canEdit={editable}
              dirty={dirty}
              // The same bar, the same way round, as the sibling route in this
              // group -- see `refusal` above.
              requireDirty={false}
              // Stale the moment anything is typed: the refusal says there is
              // nothing to save, and there now is.
              problems={dirty ? [] : refusal}
              pending={update.isPending}
              error={update.error}
              saved={update.isSuccess && !dirty}
              onSave={submit}
            />
            {update.isSuccess && !dirty && update.data.identity_locale_synced === false ? (
              // NON-BLOCKING: the save succeeded and the console already
              // switched; this only says the sign-in pages did not follow.
              <p role="status" className="notice gold" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                <Icon name={KIND_ICON.warn} size={16} />
                <span>{t("profile.page.languageNotMirrored")}</span>
              </p>
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </Panel>

      <Panel title={t("profile.security.title")} subtitle={t("profile.security.subtitle")}>
        <p className="note">{t("profile.security.note")}</p>
        <div className="form-actions">
          {/* A LINK, BECAUSE IT GOES SOMEWHERE: it opens a page of this
              console and changes nothing by itself. Drawn as the kit's button
              (`btn`), the way Reports and Jobs draw theirs. */}
          <Link className="btn" to="/profile/security">
            <Icon name="shield-lock" size={14} />
            <span>{t("profile.security.open")}</span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </Panel>
    </>
  );
}
```
